senses.gloss: पक्ष- + आघात पक्ष- + आघात, m. Hemiplegy.
पक्व- + आशय पक्व- + आशय, m. the abdomen, MBh. 3, 13973.
पक्ष- + आहार पक्ष- + आहार, adj. taking food only twice a month, MBh. 3, 15409.
पक्षिकीट पक्षिकीट, i. e. पक्षिन्-, m. an insect-like bird, a paltry bird, Pañc. 75, 19.
पक्ष- + गम पक्ष- + गम, adj. flying, [] Rām. 3, 56, 45.
पक्षगम पक्ष-गम, and पक्षंगम पक्षंगम, i. e. पक्ष + म्-गम, Moving by means of wings, flying, Rām. 5, 56, 45; 4, 43, 15.
पक्ष- + द्वार पक्ष- + द्वार, n. a side-door.

पक्ष- + धर पक्ष- + धर,
 I. adj. Siding with, MBh. 1, 7507.
 II. m. a bird, Hariv. 11852.
पक्कण पक्कण, m. The but of a Cāṇḍāla, or one of the outcast tribes, Kāśīkh. 12, 16.

पक्ति पक्ति, i. e. पच् + ति, f.
 1. Cooking, Man. 9, 11.
 2. Digestion, 12, 120.
 3. Ripening, development, MBh. 12, 9745 (read पक्ति instead of पङ्क्ति).
 4. Dignity, Suśr. 1, 51, 20.

पक्तृ पक्तृ, i. e. पच् + तृ, m., f. त्री, and n.
 1. Cooking, a cook, MBh. 12, 10935.
 2. Promoting digestion, Suśr. 1, 189, 13.

पक्व पक्व, i. e. पच् + व. It is used as ptcple. of the pf. pass. of पच्, f. वा.
 1. Cooked, Man. 4, 223.
 2. Baked (as a brick, a pot), Yājñ. 1, 197.
 3. Mature, Hit. i. d. 144.
 4. Grey (as hair), Lass. Anth. 80, 17.
 5. Accomplished, perfect.
 6. On the eve of decay, Bhāg. P. 4, 28, 38.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. πέπων (from which we may infer that पक्व is curtailed पक्वन्), πεπανός, with ρ for ν, curtailed in δρυπεπής, δρύπεψ.
पक्वण पक्वण = पक्कण, MBh. 12, 5330.
पक्वापक्वा पक्वापक्वा, a sound imitative of the ery of birds.
† पक्ष् पक्ष्, i. 1 and 10, Par. To seize; cf. पश्.

पक्ष पक्ष, m.
 1. A wing; also n., Mārk. P. 9, 15.
 2. The feathers of an arrow.
 3. A flank, a side, Ragh. 5, 72.
 4. Half.
 5. The half of a lunar [] month, comprising fifteen days, Man. 1, 66.
 6. Party, Rām. 2, 18, 13 Gorr. (he who sides with Bharata).
 7. A partisan, Vikr. d. 16.
 8. A friend, Hariv. 3013.
 9. A class, a host, a troop, MBh. 13, 3315; Hariv. 7124.
 10. Place, condition, Rām. 6, 99, 32.
 11. Alternative, Ragh. 4, 10.
 12. Opinion, MBh. 2, 2266.
 13. The subject of an inference, Bhāṣāp. 67.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. perhaps παξ in ἅπαξ.

पक्षक पक्ष + क,
 I. m. A side, Śiś. 11, 7.
 II. A substitute for पक्ष when latter part of a comp. adj.
पक्षता पक्ष + ता, f. Alliance, MBh. 2, 2665.
पक्षति पक्ष + ति, f. The root of a wing, Rājat. 1, 374.

पक्षवन्त् पक्ष + वन्त्, adj., f. वती.
 1. Winged, Rām. 4, 63, 5.
 2. Of a noble extraction, MBh. 13, 2965.
पक्षशस् पक्ष + शस्, adv. By, or for fortnights, MBh. 13, 5659.
पक्षि पक्षि, i. e. curtailed पक्षिन्, m. A bird, MBh. 12, 9306.

पक्षिन् पक्षिन्, i. e. पक्ष + इन्,
 I. adj., f. इणी.
 1. Winged (figuratively).
 2. Siding with; in कृष्ण-पक्ष + इन्, Hariv. 4559.
 3. fem. with रात्रि (a night), accompanied by the foregoing and following day, Man. 4, 97.
 II. m.
 1. A bird, Man. 1, 44.
 2. A name of Śiva, MBh. 13, 1183.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. Goth. fugl; A.S. fugul.
पक्षिमृगता पक्षिमृगता, i. e. पक्षिन्-मृग + ता, f. The form of a bird or beast, Man. 12, 9.
पक्षीय पक्षीय, i. e. पक्ष + ईय, in कृष्ण-पक्ष + ईय, adj. Siding with Kṛṣṇa, Hariv. 3748.

पक्ष्मन् पक्ष्मन् (akin to पक्ष), n. An eye-lash, Suśr. 1, 115, 10.
 --Comp.

पक्ष्मल पक्ष्मल, i. e. पक्ष्मन् + अ, with ल् for न्, adj.
 1. Having long eye-lashes, Kathās. 18, 14.
 2. Hairy, Śiś. 4, 61.

पाक पाक, i. e. पच् + अ, m.
 1. Cooking, baking, MBh. 3, 15551.
 2. Food, Man. 3, 104.
 3. Burning (as pots, bricks), 5, 122.
 4. Digestion.
 5. Ripening, maturing, Vikr. d. 90.
 6. The appearance of the consequences, e. g. of an action, Pañc. 129, 13.
 7. Fulfilling, accomplishment.
 8. Inflammation.
 9. The name of a demon.
 --Comp.

पाकज पाक-ज, adj. Produced by maturing.
 --Comp.
पाकजत्व पाकज + त्व. n. Capability of being affected by contact with fire, Bhāṣāp. 104.

पाकशासन पाक-शासन, m. A name of Indra, Vikr. 89, 1 (chastiser of पाक, see पाक
 9).
पाकशासनि पाकशासनि, i. e. पाक-शासन + इ, patronym., m. A son of Indra, a surname of Arjuna, Johns. Sel. 17, 72.
पाकिन् पाकिन्, i. e. पच् + इन्, latter part of comp. adj., f. नि, Maturing, being digested.
पाकिम पाकिम, i. e. पाक + इम, adj. Prepared by cooking, baking, or evaporation (as salt).
पाक्य पाक्य, i. e. पाक + य, adj., n. A kind of salt.
पाक्षिक पाक्षिक, i. e. पक्ष + इक, adj., f. की, Belonging to a fortnight, MBh. 14, 2513.
पक्ष- + पात पक्ष- + पात, m. 1. siding with somebody, MBh. 1, 5347. 2. partiality, Bhartṛ. 1, 54.
पक्ष- + पातिन् पक्ष- + पातिन्, adj. siding with, partial, Mālav. 13, 17.
पक्ष- + पुट पक्ष- + पुट, m. a wing.
पाक- + मत्स्य पाक- + मत्स्य, m. 1. a particular fish, Suśr. 1, 206, 17. 2. a poisonous kind of insect, ib. 2, 288, 3.
पाक- + यज्ञ पाक- + यज्ञ, m. a domestic sacrifice, Man. 2, 86; 11, 118.
पक्ष- + रचना पक्ष- + रचना, f. winning friends, Daśak. in Chr. 185, 21.
पक्ष- + वाद पक्ष- + वाद, m. uttering one's opinion, MBh. 7, 6009.
पाक- + शाला पाक- + शाला, f. the kitchen, Lass. 81, 5.
